title: Writing / Style / Numerals
slide_intent: Format numbers according to reading context so quantities are easy to scan without making sentence openings awkward.
strategic_value: Explicit exceptions for sentence starts and product currencies can help Duolingo keep numbers consistent across prose and interfaces.
demonstration: Four preferred examples are compared with four alternatives for streaks, sentence starts, thousands and XP.
practical_value: Use numerals by default, then check the sentence-opening and product-currency exceptions.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Numerals heading and two rule paragraphs at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Set Like this examples above Not this alternatives at right, including comma-separated ordinary quantities and unseparated XP.

reference_purposes.Application: Worked examples cover a streak, a sentence-opening number, a large quantity and XP.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source requires numerals by default, spelled-out sentence starts, commas above 999, and no commas for XP or other product currency totals.

ingredient.name: Number formatting
ingredient.application: Use numerals, spell out sentence-opening numbers or rewrite large ones, and separate values above 999 with commas except product currency totals.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior.
